The first build of Webber: a clean Chromium-based browser that uses your Omarchy theme and can be used by Claude.

## Install on Linux / Omarchy

1. Download **Webber-<version>-x86_64.AppImage** and **install-linux.sh** below.
2. Run:

```bash
bash ~/Downloads/install-linux.sh ~/Downloads/Webber-<version>-x86_64.AppImage
```

Webber then shows up in your app launcher. Add `--default` to the end to also make it your default browser. If it doesn't start, run `sudo pacman -S fuse2`.

You can also just make the AppImage executable and double-click it.

## What's in it

- Vertical tabs in a sidebar, round pinned-tab icons, and a compact mode (`Ctrl+B`)
- An address bar that drops down from the top and suggests your open tabs and history
- Colors from your Omarchy theme, updating live when you switch themes
- Ad and tracker blocking
- A Claude connector, off by default. Turn it on from the ✳ button in the sidebar.
